bibl.title: Cortical interneurons that specialize in disinhibitory control

person.p: the tag layer; a sentence written by the tagger about the paper, always anchored to a quotation but not itself a quotation

span.label: VIP-expressing cortical interneurons and the disinhibitory circuit they form
span.quote: Here we show that a class of interneurons that express vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP) mediates disinhibitory control in multiple areas of neocortex and is recruited by reinforcement signals.

span.label: whether a specific interneuron type mediates disinhibition in vivo, and under what behavioural conditions it is recruited
span.quote: However, whether and how VIP interneurons mediate disinhibition in vivo and when they are recruited during behaviour has remained elusive.

span.label: maps one circuit function onto one molecularly defined cell type in two cortical areas, and identifies reinforcement feedback as the condition that recruits it
span.quote: Genetic targeting and optical activation enabled us to map a particular circuit function, disinhibitory control, onto a molecularly defined cell-type.

span.label: mechanism
span.quote: We identified a basic disinhibitory circuit module in which activation of VIP interneurons transiently suppresses primarily somatostatin- and a fraction of parvalbumin-expressing inhibitory interneurons that specialize in the control of the input and output of principal cells, respectively 3 , 6 , 16 , 17 .

span.label: cortical disinhibition by VIP interneurons
span.quote: A unique mode of inhibitory control may be provided by inhibitory neurons that specifically suppress the firing of other inhibitory neurons.

span.label: electrophysiology
span.quote: By combining optogenetic activation with single cell recordings, we examined the functional role of VIP interneurons in awake mice, and investigated the underlying circuit mechanisms in vitro in auditory and medial prefrontal cortices.

span.label: mechanisms
span.quote: This excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence, observed in two functionally different cortical regions, is the signature of a disinhibition process: activated VIP interneurons inhibit other interneurons, releasing some pyramidal neurons from inhibitory control.

span.label: mechanisms
span.quote: Based on these observations we propose that disinhibitory control by VIP interneurons provides a powerful circuit mechanism that enables long-range cortical signals or subcortical neuromodulation to efficiently modulate specific pyramidal neuron ensembles.

span.label: mechanisms
span.quote: By rapidly relaying this signal primarily to tone-selective neurons locally, VIP interneurons might contribute to cortical learning mechanisms.

span.label: mechanisms
span.quote: we propose that the disinhibitory microcircuit mediated by VIP expressing interneurons represents a conserved motif in neocortex

span.label: the excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence after a light pulse is read as the signature of disinhibition: VIP cells inhibit other interneurons, releasing pyramidal cells
span.quote: This excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence, observed in two functionally different cortical regions, is the signature of a disinhibition process: activated VIP interneurons inhibit other interneurons, releasing some pyramidal neurons from inhibitory control.

span.label: VIP cells inhibit a large fraction of Som interneurons and a smaller fraction of Pv interneurons, with different decay constants and depression
span.quote: VIP activation elicited IPSCs in a smaller fraction of Pv interneurons ( Fig 2b, d ). Inhibitory currents (IPSCs) recorded in Pv neurons decayed faster than those recorded from Som neurons (decay time constant; Som: 18±2ms, Pv: 6±1ms), and also displayed stronger short-term synaptic depression

span.label: pyramidal neurons are only a minor monosynaptic target, so the effect on them is indirect
span.quote: In contrast to these inhibitory neurons only a small fraction of pyramidal neurons responded to VIP activation, suggesting that pyramidal neurons are a minor monosynaptic target of the VIP population

span.label: the disinhibited population is functionally specific - biased toward tone-responsive, frequency-tuned cells
span.quote: These results reveal that in auditory cortex, the VIP circuit disinhibits a functionally specific subset of neurons that tend to be tone-responsive and frequency-tuned.

span.label: inhibited cells show divisive gain modulation while delayed-activated cells show an additive baseline shift
span.quote: We found that one-parameter gain modulation models (additive or multiplicative) fitted the light-induced changes in average tuning curves: the inhibited population showed divisive gain modulation 9 , 26 , whereas the change in delayed activated neurons was consistent with an additive shift of the baseline firing rate

span.label: VIP cells are proposed as the substrate by which long-range or neuromodulatory signals raise the gain of specific pyramidal ensembles
span.quote: Based on these observations we propose that disinhibitory control by VIP interneurons provides a powerful circuit mechanism that enables long-range cortical signals or subcortical neuromodulation to efficiently modulate specific pyramidal neuron ensembles.

span.label: cell identity in vivo is inferred from spike width and firing rate, then confirmed in vitro with genetic labels and by c-Fos with a pyramidal marker
span.quote: Many, but not all neurons in this inhibited group had narrow spike widths (ACx: 237±7μs, mPFC: 225±7μs) and high firing rates (ACx: 7.4±0.7Hz, mPFC: 17.5±4.2Hz; see Extended Data Fig. 2f, g ), hallmarks of fast-spiking interneurons, usually expressing parvalbumin (Pv)

span.label: How far this circuit overlaps with the previously described layer 1 disinhibitory circuit is undetermined.
span.quote: However, the extent to which these two disinhibitory circuits overlap remains to be determined, as only a fraction of layer 1 interneurons express VIP.

span.label: The experimenter could not be fully blinded.
span.quote: Conducting the experiments required monitoring the effect of VIP-photostimulation on multiunit activity; therefore, it was not possible to fully blind the experimenter.

span.label: The immunohistochemical estimate of VIP expression specificity and efficiency is not a gold-standard measure.
span.quote: However, we would like to note that this approach has some limitations, as immunohistochemistry is not considered a gold standard method for assessing gene expression, since both its specificity and sensitivity depends on external factors 21 , 35 .

span.label: the experimenter could not be fully blinded, because finding the effect was necessary to position the electrodes; disclosed with its mitigation
span.quote: Conducting the experiments required monitoring the effect of VIP-photostimulation on multiunit activity; therefore, it was not possible to fully blind the experimenter. However, this information was only used to guide decisions about whether to move the electrodes or not.

span.label: immunohistochemistry, used to estimate the specificity of VIP labelling, is stated by the authors not to be a gold standard for gene expression
span.quote: However, we would like to note that this approach has some limitations, as immunohistochemistry is not considered a gold standard method for assessing gene expression, since both its specificity and sensitivity depends on external factors 21 , 35 . These factors include but are not restricted to (i) celltype-specific availability of the epitope 36 , (ii) varying expression levels and subcellular patterns of the antigens 35 , 37 , (iii) details of the experimental procedure

span.label: the exclusion thresholds were relaxed for VIP cells specifically, using light-evoked waveform correlation instead
span.quote: Some of the VIP neurons did not reach the threshold of isolation distance and L-ratio. For these neurons, we exploited the waveform information carried by light-evoked action potentials, which aided the isolation of these units. We calculated waveform correlation between spontaneous action potentials of VIP neurons and average light-evoked waveform. We restricted the clusters to the upper 5 percentile of the bootstrapped distribution of correlation coefficients.

span.label: analysis windows differed between the two recorded areas, chosen from the observed response latencies
span.quote: For the mPFC, minimal and maximal firing was determined as the minimum and maximum of the SDF within 100 ms from the light pulses. The baseline firing rate was calculated from mean firing probability within a 100 ms window before the start of a pulse train. For ACx longer windows were used according to the observed differences in response latencies (200 ms after light flashes for response and 400 ms before light pulses for baseline).

span.label: datasets were pooled across layers and areas on the strength of null results rather than demonstrated equivalence
span.quote: There was no significant differences in IPSC amplitude and fraction of responded neurons in different cortical layers and the results were combined. Som and Pv showed similar short-term plasticity in ACx and mPFC. Hence, the two data sets were combined.

span.label: the difference in VIP yield between the two areas is attributed to delivery method rather than biology
span.quote: The difference in the relative proportion of recorded VIP neurons in ACx and mPFC is likely due to technical reasons. First, ChR2 was delivered virally into mPFC, whereas we used a reporter line (Ai32) for ACx. Therefore, ChR2 expression in mPFC was spatially limited and the level of expression could vary. Second, superficial layers in mPFC were more difficult to target because they are located underneath midline blood vessels.

span.label: the overlap between this circuit and the layer 1 disinhibitory circuit is left undetermined
span.quote: However, the extent to which these two disinhibitory circuits overlap remains to be determined, as only a fraction of layer 1 interneurons express VIP.

span.label: synchronous optogenetic activation is defended as physiologically plausible by appeal to the homogeneity of the natural response, which is an argument rather than a control
span.quote: The homogeneous behavioural recruitment of VIPs suggests that the synchronous ChR2-mediated activation to probe their circuit function was physiologically plausible.

span.label: gating and gain modulation as the functions a disinhibitory motif could serve
span.quote: A unique mode of inhibitory control may be provided by inhibitory neurons that specifically suppress the firing of other inhibitory neurons. Such disinhibition could lead to the selective amplification of local processing and serve the important computational functions of gating and gain modulation

span.label: Bayesian information criterion used to choose between additive, divisive and combined descriptions of a tuning-curve change
span.quote: This model resulted in only marginal improvement relative to the divisive model for the inhibited group (Bayesian information criterion 34 for the combined, divisive gain and baseline shift models: −399.6, −398.3 and −354.7) and the baseline shift model for the delayed activated group (Bayesian information criterion for the combined, multiplicative gain and baseline shift models: −274.7, −146.7 and −270.2). Thus, the effect of VIP stimulation on auditory tuning curves is explained by the divisive gain modulation of inhibited cells and the additive firing rate change of the delayed activated neurons.

span.label: disinhibition here is a specific circuit motif - inhibitory cells targeting other inhibitory cells - not a general loosening of inhibition
span.quote: A unique mode of inhibitory control may be provided by inhibitory neurons that specifically suppress the firing of other inhibitory neurons. Such disinhibition could lead to the selective amplification of local processing and serve the important computational functions of gating and gain modulation

span.label: VIP names a molecular marker used as a cell class; the paper's whole argument is that a marker-defined population has a single circuit function
span.quote: Genetic targeting and optical activation enabled us to map a particular circuit function, disinhibitory control, onto a molecularly defined cell-type.

span.label: Pv identity in the in vivo data is a PROXY: inferred from narrow spike width and high firing rate, hedged as many but not all and usually
span.quote: Many, but not all neurons in this inhibited group had narrow spike widths (ACx: 237±7μs, mPFC: 225±7μs) and high firing rates (ACx: 7.4±0.7Hz, mPFC: 17.5±4.2Hz; see Extended Data Fig. 2f, g ), hallmarks of fast-spiking interneurons, usually expressing parvalbumin (Pv)

span.label: gain modulation is split into two distinguishable senses here - divisive (multiplying the tuning curve) versus an additive baseline shift - and the two populations show different ones
span.quote: We found that one-parameter gain modulation models (additive or multiplicative) fitted the light-induced changes in average tuning curves: the inhibited population showed divisive gain modulation 9 , 26 , whereas the change in delayed activated neurons was consistent with an additive shift of the baseline firing rate

span.label: impact and recruitment are coined by this paper as the two directions of a cell type's role: what it drives, and what drives it
span.quote: VIP interneurons function within a highly interconnected network, therefore their role can be understood as pre-synaptic drivers of (‘impact’) and post-synaptic responders to (‘recruitment’) other neurons.

span.label: SDF, PSTH and PETH are used for the same computed object in this paper, with the renaming declared in the text
span.quote: Next, we estimated peri-stimulus (stimulus-aligned) firing rates by using an adaptive spike density function (SDF) approach (termed peri-stimulus time histogram and abbreviated PSTH hereinafter).

span.label: extends → previous connectivity-based proposals that VIP interneurons provide disinhibitory control (refs 10-12)
span.quote: These data represent the first in vivo demonstration of cell-type-specific disinhibition, confirming previous suggestions based on connectivity 10 – 12 that VIP interneurons provide disinhibitory control.

span.label: confirms → connectivity-based proposals that VIP interneurons specialise in targeting other interneurons
span.quote: These data represent the first in vivo demonstration of cell-type-specific disinhibition, confirming previous suggestions based on connectivity 10 – 12 that VIP interneurons provide disinhibitory control.

span.label: extends → the layer 1 disinhibitory circuit enabling associative learning
span.quote: However, the extent to which these two disinhibitory circuits overlap remains to be determined, as only a fraction of layer 1 interneurons express VIP.

span.label: qualifies → the additive account of how VIP activation changes tuning curves
span.quote: However, non-linear transformations such as a threshold operation in combination with a baseline shift can in theory yield similar or better results compared to the activity gain model

span.label: supports → the view that different interneuron types perform distinct circuit operations
span.quote: Cortical inhibitory interneurons display great diversity in their physiology, connectivity and synaptic dynamics, but it has long been debated whether and to what extent function of an interneuron type follows from a unique combination of these properties

span.label: generalises → the disinhibitory motif across cytoarchitectonically different cortical areas
span.quote: Based on the strong disinhibitory impact and target selectivity observed in two cytoarchitectonically and functionally different cortical areas, we propose that the disinhibitory microcircuit mediated by VIP expressing interneurons represents a conserved motif in neocortex.

span.label: VIP interneurons —causes→ Som
span.quote: Activation of VIP interneurons elicited IPSCs from a large fraction of Som interneurons ( Fig 2a, d ). Repeated stimulation of VIP neurons at 40Hz revealed that these inhibitory connections onto Som interneurons undergo short-term synaptic depression

span.label: VIP interneurons —causes→ Pv
span.quote: VIP activation elicited IPSCs in a smaller fraction of Pv interneurons ( Fig 2b, d ). Inhibitory currents (IPSCs) recorded in Pv neurons decayed faster than those recorded from Som neurons (decay time constant; Som: 18±2ms, Pv: 6±1ms), and also displayed stronger short-term synaptic depression

span.label: fast-spiking interneurons —operationalised-as→ Pv

span.label: narrow spike widths —operationalised-as→ fast-spiking interneurons
span.quote: Many, but not all neurons in this inhibited group had narrow spike widths (ACx: 237±7μs, mPFC: 225±7μs) and high firing rates (ACx: 7.4±0.7Hz, mPFC: 17.5±4.2Hz; see Extended Data Fig. 2f, g ), hallmarks of fast-spiking interneurons, usually expressing parvalbumin (Pv)

span.quote: We found that one-parameter gain modulation models (additive or multiplicative) fitted the light-induced changes in average tuning curves: the inhibited population showed divisive gain modulation 9 , 26 , whereas the change in delayed activated neurons was consistent with an additive shift of the baseline firing rate

span.label: VIP-expressing interneurons carry out disinhibitory control across several neocortical areas and are switched on by reinforcement signals.
span.quote: Here we show that a class of interneurons that express vasoactive intestinal polypeptide (VIP) mediates disinhibitory control in multiple areas of neocortex and is recruited by reinforcement signals.

span.label: The circuit module is VIP activation transiently suppressing somatostatin interneurons and a subset of parvalbumin interneurons, which respectively control principal-cell input and output.
span.quote: We identified a basic disinhibitory circuit module in which activation of VIP interneurons transiently suppresses primarily somatostatin- and a fraction of parvalbumin-expressing inhibitory interneurons that specialize in the control of the input and output of principal cells, respectively

span.label: Pyramidal neurons are only a minor direct target of VIP cells; the effect on them is indirect.
span.quote: In contrast to these inhibitory neurons only a small fraction of pyramidal neurons responded to VIP activation, suggesting that pyramidal neurons are a minor monosynaptic target of the VIP population

span.label: VIP-evoked IPSCs in parvalbumin cells decay about three times faster than in somatostatin cells and depress more strongly with repeated stimulation.
span.quote: Inhibitory currents (IPSCs) recorded in Pv neurons decayed faster than those recorded from Som neurons (decay time constant; Som: 18±2ms, Pv: 6±1ms), and also displayed stronger short-term synaptic depression

span.label: c-Fos labelling shows the delayed-activated cells are pyramidal (CaMKIIα-positive) rather than VIP neurons.
span.quote: Eight percent of c-Fos-immunopositive neurons expressed VIP, while the others expressed the pyramidal marker CaMKIIα

span.label: The disinhibited cells in auditory cortex are not random: they are preferentially the tone-responsive, frequency-tuned neurons.
span.quote: These results reveal that in auditory cortex, the VIP circuit disinhibits a functionally specific subset of neurons that tend to be tone-responsive and frequency-tuned.

span.label: VIP stimulation changes tuning curves in two different ways: divisively scaling down the inhibited cells and additively raising the baseline of the delayed-activated cells.
span.quote: Thus, the effect of VIP stimulation on auditory tuning curves is explained by the divisive gain modulation of inhibited cells and the additive firing rate change of the delayed activated neurons.

span.label: Every recorded VIP neuron was phasically activated by punishment at short latency, and the same response followed both air puff and foot shock, indicating a general aversive-feedback signal.
span.quote: In all VIP neurons punishment (air puff, n=6 or foot shock, n=4) generated strong phasic activation at short latencies (peak at 50±12ms, p<0.01).

span.label: VIP neurons respond to reinforcement uniformly as a class, unlike the heterogeneous responses of the surrounding cortical population.
span.quote: These results reveal that VIP interneurons respond in unison to reinforcement feedback, distinct from the more diverse responses observed in the rest of the cortical population.

span.label: The study maps a specific circuit operation, disinhibition, onto a genetically defined cell type.
span.quote: Genetic targeting and optical activation enabled us to map a particular circuit function, disinhibitory control, onto a molecularly defined cell-type.

span.label: activating 1-2% of cortical neurons changed firing in about 20% of them
span.quote: This excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence, observed in two functionally different cortical regions, is the signature of a disinhibition process: activated VIP interneurons inhibit other interneurons, releasing some pyramidal neurons from inhibitory control.

span.label: an excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence appears in two functionally different cortical areas
span.quote: This excitation-inhibition-excitation sequence, observed in two functionally different cortical regions, is the signature of a disinhibition process: activated VIP interneurons inhibit other interneurons, releasing some pyramidal neurons from inhibitory control.

span.label: first in vivo demonstration of cell-type-specific disinhibition
span.quote: These data represent the first in vivo demonstration of cell-type-specific disinhibition, confirming previous suggestions based on connectivity 10 – 12 that VIP interneurons provide disinhibitory control.

span.label: VIP cells inhibit a large fraction of Som and a smaller fraction of Pv interneurons
span.quote: Activation of VIP interneurons elicited IPSCs from a large fraction of Som interneurons ( Fig 2a, d ). Repeated stimulation of VIP neurons at 40Hz revealed that these inhibitory connections onto Som interneurons undergo short-term synaptic depression

span.label: pyramidal cells are only a minor direct target of VIP cells
span.quote: In contrast to these inhibitory neurons only a small fraction of pyramidal neurons responded to VIP activation, suggesting that pyramidal neurons are a minor monosynaptic target of the VIP population

span.label: the disinhibited cells are disproportionately tone-responsive and frequency-tuned
span.quote: These results reveal that in auditory cortex, the VIP circuit disinhibits a functionally specific subset of neurons that tend to be tone-responsive and frequency-tuned.

span.label: punishment activates every recorded VIP neuron at short latency, and two different punishments do the same
span.quote: We found that VIP neurons showed surprisingly homogeneous responses to reinforcement feedback signals ( Fig. 4c–f and Extended Data Fig. 8 ). In all VIP neurons punishment (air puff, n=6 or foot shock, n=4) generated strong phasic activation at short latencies (peak at 50±12ms, p<0.01). The similar activation in response to two different types of punishment suggests that VIP neurons signal the aversive quality of the negative feedback.

span.label: VIP cells respond in unison where the rest of the population responds heterogeneously
span.quote: These results reveal that VIP interneurons respond in unison to reinforcement feedback, distinct from the more diverse responses observed in the rest of the cortical population.

span.label: the divisive gain model beat a baseline shift plus threshold in 22 of 25 inhibited neurons
span.quote: The activity gain model resulted in better fits (smaller least square errors) than the baseline shift combined with a threshold operation at 0 Hz in the case of 22 out of 25 neurons; the combined model resulted in smaller errors in 2 neurons and the fits were indistinguishable for 1 cell.
